classes.name: TweenService
classes.doc: Makes tweens: animations of instance properties over time.

methods.name: Create
methods.doc: A new tween that animates the named properties of the instance to the given goal values. Numbers, booleans, Vector3, Vector2, CFrame, Color3, UDim, UDim2, Rect and NumberRange properties can be tweened; any other type raises RE9352.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.doc: The eased value of alpha (clamped to 0..1) for this style and direction.

classes.name: TweenBase
classes.doc: What every tween can do: play, pause and cancel, with its playback state.

properties.name: PlaybackState
properties.doc: Where the tween is: Begin, Delayed, Playing, Paused, Completed or Cancelled.

methods.name: Play
methods.doc: Starts the tween from the current property values, or resumes it when paused. Cancels other running tweens of the same instance that animate one of the same properties.

methods.name: Pause
methods.doc: Stops the tween where it is; Play resumes it.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.doc: Stops the tween where it is and fires Completed with Cancelled; the next Play starts over.

events.name: Completed
events.doc: Fires when the tween finishes (Completed) or is cancelled (Cancelled).

classes.name: Tween
classes.doc: A property animation made by TweenService:Create.

properties.name: Instance
properties.doc: The instance whose properties the tween animates.

properties.name: TweenInfo
properties.doc: Not readable here: keep the TweenInfo you passed to Create. Raises RE9001.
